summary: East edge of a cul-de-sac turning circle, backing onto bush, with homes about 17 m off.
reasons: Homes about 17 m across the circle

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the east side screens the main road; houses on the west side of the bulb sit about 17 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed cul-de-sac with room to pull in off the through lane; a white van and two cars are parked in the bulb.
drivers.traffic: Busy road about 40 m east, hidden by bush; the cul-de-sac itself is quiet.
drivers.convention: Cars park in the bulb, so a van will not stand out; no signs.

flags: Noise from the main road to the east
Slope about 2%, max 4.6% on one 5 m step
Homes about 17 m away across the turning circle
sun_shade: Bush shades the east and south; open to afternoon sun from the west.

best_section.where: East side of the cul-de-sac head, beside the bush strip
